description.zh:
边缘实例ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**边缘实例**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~)接口获取。
description.en:
The ID of the edge instance. To obtain the instance ID, perform the following steps: Log on to the [Link IoT Edge console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list). On the **Edge Instances** page, move the pointer over the name of the edge instance that you want to manage and obtain the instance ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) operation to query the instance ID.

description.zh:
要查询的设备ID列表。可调用[QueryEdgeInstanceDevice](~~135261~~)查询实例中的设备ID。

>单次调用最多可填写20个设备ID。
description.en:
The list of device IDs to query. You can call the [QueryEdgeInstanceDevice](~~135261~~) API to query the device IDs in the instance.

> You can specify up to 20 device IDs in a single invocation.

description.zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。
description.en: The ID of the Internet of Things (IoT) service instance. This parameter is not required for the public instance but required for Enterprise Edition instances.

title.zh: 批量清空边缘实例设备配置
title.en: Batch Delete Device Configurations from an Edge Instance

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为5。
> RAM用户共享主账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Conditions
Each Alibaba Cloud account can send a maximum of 5 queries per second (QPS) to invoke this API.
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
